title: Resources
subtitle: Mint resources (Authplane mints tokens) and Broker resources (Authplane brokers an upstream credential).
uriHttpRequired: Must be an http or https URL
providerRequired: Provider is required for broker resources
scopeRequired: At least one scope is required
scopeNeedsUpstream: Scope '{{name}}' needs an upstream mapping for broker resources
searchPlaceholder: Search by slug, URI, name, or provider…
empty: No resources registered. Create one to start minting or brokering tokens.
createInfo: Mint resources mint Authplane-issued JWTs. Broker resources vend an upstream credential held in the configured provider.
editInfo: Only fields you touch are sent on save (PATCH). Untouched fields are left unchanged on the server — including the cross-client allowlist and runtime client list.
switchKindAfter: will remove the upstream mapping from every existing scope. The scope names + descriptions are preserved; the upstream values are not.
clearAllowlistAfter: client to act for this resource (user consent still applies, except for Mint self-exchange and fronted exchanges). Use this only when the resource intentionally has no per-client restriction.
deleteAfter: will fail with 409 if any consent grants or live issuances still reference it — revoke them first. Fronting links pointing to or from this resource also block delete; you'll get a cascade-confirm modal listing them if so.
cascadeDeleteAfter: . Deleting this resource will also remove these links atomically:
brokerDescription: Authplane brokers an upstream credential held in the configured provider. Tokens vended are opaque upstream tokens.
mintDescription: Authplane mints audience-scoped JWTs for this resource. The resource's URI is the audience claim.
brokerUriDescription: Used as the upstream API base for diagnostics. The provider's adapter knows the actual endpoint URLs.
mintUriDescription: Used as the audience claim on minted tokens.
providerHelp: Provider must already exist. If you don't see one, create it from the Providers page first.
brokerScopesHelp: Each scope must declare its upstream mapping — the upstream scope vended at exchange time.
mintScopesHelp: Scope name + operator-facing description shown on the consent screen.
allowlistHelp: Clients allowed to act for this resource via token exchange. Empty = any client may act (user consent still applies, except for Mint self-exchange and fronted exchanges).
runtimeClientsBefore: OAuth clients authorized to act AS this resource at
runtimeClientsAfter: . Empty = default-deny: no client may act as this resource. Multi-entry models multi-tier deployments (prod / canary / dev) where each tier authenticates with its own credentials but maps to the same resource.
noRuntimeClients: (none — default-deny; no client may act as this resource)
returnUrlsHelp: URLs the connect flow may redirect to after upstream consent. Required for broker resources.
